plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for HPE Aruba Instant (IAP) cluster, collected from the Virtual Controller. It reports uptime, per-AP CPU utilization, per-AP memory, AP status, and interface traffic (enterprise PEN 14823).
name: Wireless

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the Aruba Instant Virtual Controller since the last restart (sysUpTime). Monitoring uptime helps identify unexpected reboots or VC failover.

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage

dimensions.name: index
dimensions.description: Access point MAC address (SNMP table index)

metrics.description: CPU utilization of each access point in the Aruba Instant cluster (AI-AP-MIB aiAPCPUUtilization), one series per AP. Sustained high CPU on an AP can degrade client service and roaming.

metrics.name: device_memory_total

dimensions.name: index
dimensions.description: Access point MAC address (SNMP table index)

metrics.description: Total memory of each access point in bytes (AI-AP-MIB aiAPTotalMemory).

metrics.name: device_memory_free

dimensions.name: index
dimensions.description: Access point MAC address (SNMP table index)

metrics.description: Free memory of each access point in bytes (AI-AP-MIB aiAPMemoryFree).

metrics.name: device_memory_usage

dimensions.name: index
dimensions.description: Access point MAC address (SNMP table index)

metrics.description: Memory utilization of each access point, computed as (total - free) / total * 100 from aiAPTotalMemory and aiAPMemoryFree. High memory pressure can cause client association failures.

metrics.name: wireless_ap_state

dimensions.name: index
dimensions.description: Access point MAC address (SNMP table index)

metrics.description: Status of each access point known to the Virtual Controller (AI-AP-MIB aiAPStatus, raw up(1) / down(2)), normalized so that 1 = up and 2 = down.
